The '''Medal of the Emperor's Fist''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] medal awarded for "''distinguished services to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] in strengthening and maintaining galactic peace.''"<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Medal of the Emperor's Fist}}</ref> Its [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] equivalent was presumably the [[Medal of Bothawui]].<ref name="SWG:BtDMtWT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bring the Droid Modules to Wilson Tchorshel|Naboo}}</ref> The medal had a black ribbon with purple linings, as well as three silver dots on each side near the medal. In addition, the medal itself possessed a tower-like design at the top, which ended with three prongs, and the circular medal featured an engraving that resembled the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]].<ref name="SWGTCG" /> Its design very similar to the [[Medal of Honor (Imperial)/Legends|Imperial Medal of Honor]].<ref name="SWG:IMoH">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=item|Imperial Medal of Honor}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer was awarded the medal by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Vox|Vox]] for delivering four valuable [[Droid/Legends|droid]] modules to him.<ref name="SWG:BtDMtLMV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Medal of the Emperor's Fist was a player reward in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' for completing the Imperial arc of the Legacy Quest.<ref name="SWG:BtDMtLMV" />
